subject: general
question: India Plastics Pact, a joint initiative between which trade organisation and World-Wide Fund for Nature-India (WWF India), was launched in September 2021?

options.text: Indian Association of Amusement Parks and Industries

solution:
The correct answer is __**Confederation of Indian Industry**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India Plastics Pact** was launched in September 2021 as a joint initiative between the **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** and the **World-Wide Fund for Nature-India (WWF India)**.
 
• The pact aims to bring together businesses, governments, and NGOs to work towards a circular economy for plastics, reducing the environmental impact of plastic waste.
 
• It focuses on four targets: eliminating unnecessary plastic packaging, ensuring all plastic packaging is reusable or recyclable, increasing the recycling of plastic packaging, and ensuring an average of 25% recycled content in plastic packaging.
 
• The India Plastics Pact is the first of its kind in Asia and is part of a global network of Plastics Pacts that are working towards a shared vision of a world where plastics never become waste.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** is a non-government, not-for-profit, industry-led, and industry-managed organization, playing a proactive role in India’s development process.
 
• **World-Wide Fund for Nature-India (WWF India)** is one of the largest conservation organizations in India, working to promote harmony between human beings and nature.
 
• The India Plastics Pact aligns with the principles of a circular economy, which is aimed at eliminating waste and the continual use of resources.
 
• By bringing together stakeholders across the value chain, the pact seeks to drive systemic change and create a sustainable approach to plastic use and waste management.
